title: patch_file fails with template variables in removed lines
description: patch_file failed twice when the removed line contained {{run_id}}. Context lines matched but removed lines did not — likely a preprocessing or encoding issue with double-brace sequences. write_file fallback was required. This will recur on any run patching skill files.
proposed_resolution: Investigate patch_file.rs for any {{}} preprocessing. Add a unit test for patching files containing template variable syntax. Fix root cause so patch_file is reliable on skill markdown files.
